items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I know Eugene, Trombron, and Charley Boyd Banks, Syson Farm.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I think he played a job or two here on the bass. And if he went to California, he took up a band shift, a ghetto, a ghetto and a bass. And I was told that he was playing older than good. How long did you stay on Harbridge Street? I don't remember. I must have stayed there about five or six years. And when did you move to? I don't remember where I moved from then. Well, I never did get all your nephews straight. How…
He's your nephew? Yeah. What does he play like?
